messages:
Priya: FinBank just shared an Okta export and a 30-page auth requirements doc. They want a plan for: CSV bulk import, continuous SCIM delta, delegated domain onboarding (50+ domains), strict RBAC that mirrors Okta groups, and SAML with IdP-initiated flows. Can we note any gotchas and a minimal runbook I can forward? @Camille can you lead the technical sync with them?

Camille: Yep. I skimmed the export. A few high-risk items up-front: duplicate email addresses across users, some users lack externalId, a handful of service accounts listed as "Login disabled" in Okta, and ~120 groups with overlapping membership. We'll need a pre-clean step.

Jordan: Operational constraints and recommendations:
- Export cleanup: canonical primary key must be email or externalId. We prefer externalId if present; otherwise email. Deduplicate on externalId then email.
- Bulk path: recommend CSV -> presigned S3 upload -> server-side staged import job. Batch size: 8k3k users per job (we've seen 8k optimal to balance DB transactions and import time).
- Hosted SCIM rate-limits: 60 req/s sustained per-tenant; Dedicated reserved pools: ~250 req/s sustained. If they want aggressive parallel PATCHing, Dedicated recommended.
- Group PATCH limit: 2000 members per group PATCH operation. Avoid very large single-group writes; split into ranges if needed.

Jordan: SCIM delta specifics: we support incremental GET with since tokens and PATCH for single-user edits. Delta latency SLA on Dedicated: median < 18s, 95th < 60s under normal load. Hosted POC SLA is best-effort during credits. Token expiry: SCIM tokens can be rotated; we recommend rotating tokens after cutover with a 48-hour overlap window.

Jordan: SAML notes: we support HTTP-POST and HTTP-Redirect bindings and both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. Assertions must be signed (RSA-SHA256 or ECDSA-SHA256). Recommended attributes: email, givenName, familyName, groups. If they use group OIDC claims in Okta, we can accept group strings instead of SAML groups. SingleLogout supported but optional.

Jordan: Domain onboarding: we support DNS TXT and DNS CNAME verification. For 50+ domains suggest a delegated DNS handoff checklist so FinBank can automate verification (we can accept a CSV of domain + TXT token and call out any failures). We also support domain lock to prevent auto-reassignment after verification.

Jordan: RBAC mapping: we map SCIM group displayName -> Redwood role. Nested group flattening: we will flatten at import time but do not maintain nested semantics unless they provide a rule table. Need mapping file like: OktaGroupName -> target_role (and allow precedence rules). For delegated admin roles we expose a "tenant-admin" role; provisioning that role via SCIM group gives admin console access.

Camille: A few edge cases from the export: service accounts not supposed to have user licenses; flag "Login disabled" should map to active=false in SCIM. Also they have duplicate emails for shadow accounts (alias@example.com). We'll need to coordinate which record wins.

Nora: Security checklist additions: 1) We'll provide SOC2 report and network diagram. 2) SCIM over TLS1.2+, mTLS available for Private installs. 3) We store only SCIM tokens (hashed), not Okta creds. 4) Audit trail available via Console -> Audits (90d default, longer available as add-on).

Nora: For SAML security: require signed assertions + SP metadata validation. Recommend assertion encryption only if they require PII protection. For compliance, ask them to complete our short SSO security questionnaire (I'll attach). Send all requests to security@redwood.com.

Alex: Pricing/commit: Hosted POC credits cover low-volume delta syncs. For full 120k import + continuous deltas with low latency we recommend a small Dedicated commitment (monthly pool). Two options: Light (no commit, pay-as-you-go, slower throughput) vs Reserved (1-month min commit for faster capacity). I'll draft a short quote with estimated cost for a 1-month reserved pool sized for 250 req/s.

Camille: Quick runbook I propose to share (condensed):
1) Pre-clean: dedupe CSV on externalId/email, mark disabled users, export group membership.
2) Provision: create SCIM service account + token, share SAML metadata endpoints and certs.
3) Dry-run: presigned S3 upload of a 1k slice -> run import job, validate 100 users with SAML login.
4) Role mapping: provide mapping CSV OktaGroup -> RedwoodRole (with precedence).
5) Ramp: staged imports 8k3k, reconcile, split oversized group PATCHes.
6) Cutover: rotate SCIM token with 48h overlap, enable domain lock, run smoke tests.
7) Post-cutover: monitor audit logs + login success rates for 72h.

Camille: Example CSV header we asked for from FinBank (send this as the minimal template):
```
externalId,email,firstName,lastName,active,oktaGroups
ext-123,alice@finbank.com,Alice,Ng,true,TRADER;OPS
```

Camille: Example API flow for presigned upload + import kick-off:
```bash
# request presigned URL
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/admin/exports/presign -d '{"filename":"finbank-users.csv"}'
# upload to S3 (curl)
curl -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" --upload-file finbank-users.csv
# kick import
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/imports -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"source":"s3","filename":"finbank-users.csv","batch_size":10000}'
```

Priya: This is great. Two asks: 1) Camille/Triage: prepare a 1-page template for the mapping CSV and the pre-clean checklist I can send to their IdP team. 2) Alex: please produce the Dedicated quick quote. Nora: attach the SSO questionnaire and SOC2 link in the thread. I'll set the sync for Thu 11am PT.

Jordan: I'll add a short paragraph about id collision resolution (prefer externalId; if neither present we'll append +okta-id to email local-part and surface to admins for manual review).

Nora: Uploading the questionnaire to Priya and copying security@redwood.com now.

DeployBot: import-helper job queued at 3401234700 by @Camille (no user impact)

Priya: Thanks team 1. Ill send the template and confirm Thu 11am invite.
